The '''GH-44 blaster''' was a type of [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used in the [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="Deceived" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that [[Zeerid Korr]] was on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zeerid Korr]], a former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], wore twin GH-44 [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in hip [[Holster/Legends|holsters]] while delivering a cargo of weaponry to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. He sometimes replaced these with his single [[E-11 blaster pistol]].<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
GH-44 blasters were mentioned in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was published in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
